Linux kernel.label: Linux kernel based
Linux kernel.hint: Uses the Linux kernel (developed with the Linux Foundation): every Linux distribution, Android and other Linux-based systems

Debian.label: Debian based
Debian.hint: Debian and everything built on it, including Ubuntu-based systems

Ubuntu.label: Ubuntu based
Ubuntu.hint: Ubuntu (itself Debian-based) and its flavors and derivatives

Red Hat.label: Fedora based
Red Hat.hint: Fedora, RHEL and their rebuilds and derivatives

Independent Linux.label: Independent Linux
Independent Linux.hint: Linux systems with their own base, not derived from another distribution

FreeBSD.label: FreeBSD based
FreeBSD.hint: FreeBSD and systems forked or built from it, including the FreeBSD-derived userland of macOS and iOS

Windows NT.label: Windows NT based
Windows NT.hint: Built on the Windows NT kernel

Android (AOSP).label: Android based
Android (AOSP).hint: Built on the Android Open Source Project (Linux kernel underneath)

Darwin (XNU).label: Darwin based
Darwin (XNU).hint: Apple's Darwin: the XNU kernel (Mach + BSD) under macOS, iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS

UNIX System V.label: System V based
UNIX System V.hint: System V lineage: Solaris / illumos, AIX, HP-UX
